news.headline: NFL Week 10: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
news.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 10.

news.headline: Joe Burrow's 4-TD night puts QB in company of Tom Brady, Peyton Manning
news.description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions Sunday night, becoming just the third player in NFL history after Tom Brady and Peyton Manning to throw at least 20 passing touchdowns in a five-game span.

news.headline: Aaron Rodgers' 2026 NFL season: Tracking records, milestones
news.description: The Pittsburgh passer is chasing records in his 22nd NFL season, and ESPN is chronicling his "last rodeo."

news.headline: Week 10 winners and losers: McCaffrey, Gibbs and Mahomes dominate Sunday
news.description: Christian McCafffrey, Jahmyr Gibbs and Patrick Mahomes put fantasy teams on their back in Week 10, while Jonathan Taylor and the Packers and Panthers' passing games had quiet days.
news.byline: Matt Bowen and Tristan H. Cockcroft

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: Week 10's leading scorers through 'Sunday Night Football'
news.description: Kansas City rookie Emmett Johnson stepped in for Kenneth Walker III and was one of the top fantasy scorers of Week 10.

news.headline: Week 10 NFL highlights: Best plays, moments, touchdowns, more
news.description: Check here for all of Sunday's top moments, TDs and analysis from ESPN's NFL reporters.

news.headline: Aaron Rodgers makes fantasy football history, now No. 2 on all-time scoring list
news.description: With Aaron Rodgers' score on Sunday, he reaches another fantasy football accolade in his HOF-worthy career.

news.headline: 49ers put up big numbers vs. Cowboys, tout 'incredibly dangerous' offense
news.description: The 49ers racked up 584 yards against the Cowboys on Sunday in a jaw-dropping offensive display led by Brock Purdy, Christian McCaffrey and Deebo Samuel.

news.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 144-yard quarter sparks Seahawks in win over Raiders
news.description: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, the NFL's leading receiver, finished with a season-high 171 yards on eight catches, with 144 coming in the third quarter to help the Seahawks turn a three-point halftime deficit into a 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

news.headline: Schottenheimer 'very disappointed, very frustrated' with Cowboys' porous defense
news.description: Brian Schottenheimer said the Cowboys' defensive performance in the second half was a first for him after it gave up nearly 600 yards to the 49ers.

transactions.text: Signed DT Aidan Keanaaina to the practice squad. Released DT Chris Smith from the practice squad.
Waived DT Aidan Keanaaina. Reverted RB Kye Robichaux and DB Loren Strickland to injured reserve after they cleared waivers.
Signed QB Joshua Dobbs to a one-year contract. Released TE Anthony Firkser. Waived DB De'Shawn Rucker. Placed DT Aidan Keanaaina on injured reserve.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts. Signed QB Luke Altmyer, T Melvin Priestly, TE Miles Kitselman, DT Aidan Keanaaina, DEsAnthony Lucas and Eric O'Neil, DE Erick Hunter and DBs Aamaris Brown and De'Shawn Rucker to UDFA contracts.

insights: Entered the league in 2026 as an undrafted free agent.
